would snatch it up in my claws. These days, though, it tends to hang around— the soul— takes its time, malingering in that dismal, gloomy carcass. But out it comes in time, forced by the battling elements into ignominious retreat. While I wait, I plague myself with when, how, and where it will appear. Death, it seems, has grown a bit weary. Sometimes it’s actually a question of will tt or won’ it? Many a time I've looked down greedily at limbs grown rigid with rigor mortis; and what a farce that was! for the thing began to twitch and stir and rise.

@@U04631@@
(He executes fantastic gestures of conjuration.)

@@U04632@@
Hear me, devils! Up! Come! Up! On the double! You of the straight and you of the crooked horns! Devils of ancient stock, tried and true! Up! Come up! And with you bring the gaping maw of Hell Mouth! Hell-of-many-jaws devours its victims in proper rank and order! But let’s not stand on precedent, not even in this final game of parting.

@@U04633@@
(A grotesque Hell Mouth opens on the left.)

@@U04634@@
Already tusks appear, tusks are bared, the vaulted gullet yawns, spews flames, a raging sea of fury! And there
translation:
@@U04630@@
会把它抓到我的爪子里。然而如今，它往往会徘徊在周围——灵魂——需要时间，在那令人沮丧、阴沉的尸体中装病。但它及时出现了，在战斗人员的迫使下可耻地撤退。当我等待的时候，我一直在思考它何时、如何、在哪里出现。死亡，似乎变得有些厌倦了。有时候，这实际上是一个愿意还是不愿意的问题？很多时候，我贪婪地低头看着因尸僵而僵硬的四肢；那真是一场闹剧！因为那东西开始抽搐、搅动、升起。

@@U04631@@
（他做出了奇妙的咒语手势。）

@@U04632@@
听我说，恶魔们！向上！来！向上！上双！直角的你和弯角的你！古老的恶魔，久经考验，真实存在！向上！过来！并带上地狱之口张开的大嘴！众口地狱会按照适当的顺序吞噬受害者！但我们不要拘泥于先例，即使是在这最后的离别游戏中。

@@U04633@@
（一个怪异的地狱之口在左边张开。）

@@U04634@@
